segments.text: So the first question is why we use the verb permit system?
segments.zh: 第一题是：我们为什么要使用作业许可制度？

segments.text: So the first option is to renew certificates, option 2 is to make an accident lock, option 3 is to prevent an accident and option 4 is to monitor the working hours of the contractor.
segments.zh: 第一个选项是更新证书，选项 2 是制作事故锁，选项 3 是预防事故，选项 4 是监控承包商的工作时间。

segments.text: So the correct option is to select you and you can see the answer at the end.
segments.zh: 所以你要选出正确的选项，答案可以在最后看到。

segments.text: Then the second question is how long is the certificate valid for the issuer or the receiver?
segments.zh: 第二题是：签发人或接收人的证书有效期是多久？

segments.text: Option A is 90 days, option B is 6 months, option C is 2 years and option D is 1 year.
segments.zh: 选项 A 是 90 天，选项 B 是 6 个月，选项 C 是 2 年，选项 D 是 1 年。

segments.text: Then the question is who signs the certificate for the issuer or the receiver?
segments.zh: 下一题是：签发人或接收人的证书由谁签字？

segments.text: Option A is designated representative, option B is issuer or the receiver's foreman, option C is issuer or the receiver.
segments.zh: 选项 A 是指定代表，选项 B 是签发人或接收人的工长，选项 C 是签发人或接收人。

segments.text: Option D is the superintendent of the issuer or the receiver.
segments.zh: 选项 D 是签发人或接收人的主管。

segments.text: So you have to select the answer and then you have to tell you the answer at the end.
segments.zh: 所以你要选出答案，然后在最后核对答案。

segments.text: Then the next question is what is listed in the verb permit?
segments.zh: 下一题是：作业许可证上列出的是什么？

segments.text: So option A is maximum safety precaution, option B is OSHA safety precaution, option C is minimum safety precaution and option D is government safety precaution.
segments.zh: 选项 A 是最高安全预防措施，选项 B 是 OSHA 安全预防措施，选项 C 是最低安全预防措施，选项 D 是政府安全预防措施。

segments.text: So you have to select the correct answer and then you can tell you the answer at the end.
segments.zh: 所以你要选出正确答案，然后在最后核对答案。

segments.text: Then the next question is when can the issuer decide that the restricted area does not need a verb permit?
segments.zh: 下一题是：签发人在什么情况下可以决定限制区域不需要作业许可证？

segments.text: So option A is when the work is of cold work, option B is when the joint inspection of the site is not required,

segments.text: option C is when the issuer feels that the work is of low risk and option D is neighbor.
segments.zh: 选项 C 是签发人认为工作属于低风险时，选项 D 是以上都不是。

segments.text: Then the next question is when is the fire watch assigned?
segments.zh: 下一题是：什么时候要指派火灾监护人？

segments.text: So option A is for any hot work, option B is for high risk job, option C is whenever the fire occurs,
segments.zh: 选项 A 是进行任何动火作业时，选项 B 是高风险作业时，选项 C 是每当发生火灾时，

segments.text: then option D is whenever the fire occurs, then the result of the fire is more than 0.0 percent.
segments.zh: 选项 D 是每当发生火灾，且火灾的结果超过 0.0% 时。

segments.text: Then the next question is who goes for the side joint inspection?
segments.zh: 下一题是：谁去进行联合现场检查？

segments.text: So option A is designated as the craftsman or the receiver, option B is the issuer or the designated representative,
segments.zh: 选项 A 是指定的技工或接收人，选项 B 是签发人或指定代表，

segments.text: Then the next question is what are the two things that are very important to do before the work permit issue?

segments.text: So option A is the certificate of the receiver and its counter signature.

segments.text: Option C is to provide and assign the fire watch.
segments.zh: 选项 C 是配备并指派火灾监护人。

segments.text: Option D is to renew the certificates and take the counter signature.
segments.zh: 选项 D 是更新证书并取得会签。

segments.text: Then the next question is what is the need for the issuer to tell the receiver that whatever job site he is going to work on,

segments.text: Then the next question is what are the issues that the issuer and the receiver share during joint inspection?

segments.text: So the first option is the safety of the work site.

segments.text: So the question is what is the area where the work permit is required?

segments.zh: 选项 C 是特定的施工、维护和维修工作。

segments.text: And option D is that all the work done by the client is done for that.

segments.text: So option A is that this is true.

segments.text: Option B is that the extending certificates.
